The **[Allbirds Tree Dasher](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462852413332728,imageDocid:9714022430867947979,gpcid:17922086558987248935,headlineOfferDocid:9705767811048004683,catalogid:9602756854908885495,productDocid:17919549251410168984,rds:PC_17922086558987248935%7CPROD_PC_17922086558987248935&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwigoISg64OYAxVxSfEDHRMLHPcQxa4PeggIAggBCA0QAQ)** (and its refined iteration, the **[Tree Dasher 2](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462852413332728,imageDocid:9714022430867947979,gpcid:17922086558987248935,headlineOfferDocid:9281117798649324253,catalogid:9602756854908885495,productDocid:17919549251410168984,rds:PC_17922086558987248935%7CPROD_PC_17922086558987248935&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwigoISg64OYAxVxSfEDHRMLHPcQxa4PeggIAggBCA0QAg)**) `bridges the gap between a sustainable lifestyle sneaker and an active everyday runner` . Marketed as a running shoe built from natural materials, consensus among reviewers breaks down into a clear set of pros, cons, and ideal use cases.[[1]](https://www.thegoodtrade.com/features/reviews-allbirds-shoes/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4995424208144216434,catalogid:2109437914831373394,gpcid:17922086558987248935,mid:576462852413332728&ibp=oshop)

### **Key Specs & Materials** 

- **Upper:** Breathable, single-piece TENCEL™ Lyocell (eucalyptus tree fiber) and recycled polyester blend.
- **Midsole:** Sweetfoam® (made with carbon-negative sugarcane-derived EVA).
- **Outsole:** Natural rubber with enhanced traction grip pods.
- **Heel Lining:** ZQ Merino wool for a soft, anti-chafing grip.
- **Price:** Retails around $135 (though often discounted across various online outlets).
- **Care:** Machine washable (after removing the insoles and laces).[[1]](https://www.thegoodtrade.com/features/reviews-allbirds-shoes/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4995424208144216434,catalogid:2109437914831373394,gpcid:17922086558987248935,mid:576462852413332728&ibp=oshop)

### **The Pros (What People Love)** 

- **Exceptional Breathability:** The eucalyptus tree-knit upper keeps feet remarkably cool, making it a great bare-foot or sockless warm-weather shoe.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4995424208144216434,catalogid:2109437914831373394,gpcid:17922086558987248935,mid:576462852413332728&ibp=oshop)
- **Eco-Friendly Footprint:** Heavily certified (FSC-certified materials, B-Corp backing, and bio-based/recycled components) with a low carbon output compared to traditional synthetics.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4995424208144216434,catalogid:2109437914831373394,gpcid:17922086558987248935,mid:576462852413332728&ibp=oshop)
- **Sleek, Sock-Like Comfort:** The one-piece upper hugs the foot comfortably without awkward tongue bunching, and the updated heel collar on version 2 does a better job locking the ankle in place.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4995424208144216434,catalogid:2109437914831373394,gpcid:17922086558987248935,mid:576462852413332728&ibp=oshop)
- **Versatility for Casual Wear:** They look clean, minimalist, and stylish for running errands, walking the dog, or light gym sessions.[[1]](https://www.thegoodtrade.com/features/reviews-allbirds-shoes/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4995424208144216434,catalogid:2109437914831373394,gpcid:17922086558987248935,mid:576462852413332728&ibp=oshop)

### **The Cons (Where It Falls Short)** 

- **Not for Serious/Long-Distance Running:** Reviewers on platforms like [The Good Trade](https://www.thegoodtrade.com/features/reviews-allbirds-shoes/) note that they lack the rigid arch support, high energy return, and motion control needed for high-mileage runs (5+ miles) or heavy overpronation.
- **Limited Lateral Stability:** The soft, flexible knit means your foot can shift side-to-side during aggressive lateral movements (like court sports or heavy cross-training).
- **Price-to-Performance Ratio:** At around $135, they compete directly with dedicated performance running brands (like Brooks, Hoka, or Nike) that offer significantly more technical bounce and structural support.[[1]](https://www.thegoodtrade.com/features/reviews-allbirds-shoes/)

### **The Verdict: Who Is It For?** 

- **Best for:** Casual walkers, travelers, recovery days, hobby joggers doing short easy jogs (≤ 3 miles), and anyone prioritizing eco-conscious everyday comfort.[[1]](https://www.thegoodtrade.com/features/reviews-allbirds-shoes/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4995424208144216434,catalogid:2109437914831373394,gpcid:17922086558987248935,mid:576462852413332728&ibp=oshop)
- **Skip it if:** You are training for a 10K/marathon, need medical-grade stability or arch support, or want a high-intensity gym/lifting shoe.[[1]](https://www.thegoodtrade.com/features/reviews-allbirds-shoes/)
